instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show everything my account runs on its own (schedules, record changes, incoming events): what each waits for, whether it is on, its last and next run, which ones should have run and did not, and a switch to turn each off or on", and give it now_ms (The engine's time now, in milliseconds); wakes (The causes the tool rows declare: [{tool, id, on, budget}]).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-what-runs-on-its-own and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give now_ms, wakes (the causes tool rows declare: [{tool, id, on, budget}]), book (the engine's wake book record, or null) and, optionally, stamps (each watched resource's newest change stamp) and late_after_ms.
